reason: A project-analysis plugin that builds an incrementally refreshed file, symbol, and import index, then provides pointer-based project queries and byte-range reads to reduce context usage.

summaries.zh: 通过增量索引文件、符号和导入关系，并提供指针查询与字节切片读取，帮助用户更高效地阅读项目。
summaries.en: Helps users read projects efficiently by incrementally indexing files, symbols, and imports and providing pointer-based queries and byte-range reads.

capabilities: Reads project files to build an incremental file, symbol, and import index
Queries symbols, imports, file paths, and byte ranges from indexed projects
Writes oversized query results and index-related data to local files
